description: Minimize the sum of supplied nonnegative internal-diagonal weights over triangulations of a convex polygon in cyclic vertex order.

source.title: Optimal Triangulation
source.primary_method_reference: G. T. Klincsek, Minimal triangulations of polygonal domains, Annals of Discrete Mathematics 9 (1980), 121-123.
source.algorithm_attribution: Additive interval dynamic programming for minimum-weight triangulation of a convex polygon.
source.implementation_status: Bounded clean-room specialization with supplied integer diagonal weights; no geometry or source code is reused.

contract.operation: Given a strictly convex polygon represented only by its cyclic vertex labels and a nonnegative integer cost for every internal diagonal, return the minimum total cost of a triangulation.
contract.vertex_order: Vertices are 0 through n-1 in counterclockwise cyclic order. Every chord is legal because the polygon is convex.
contract.diagonal_order: Supply weights for pairs (i,j) in lexicographic order with 0<=i<j<n, j>=i+2, excluding the hull edge (0,n-1).
contract.result_encoding: Minimum sum of the n-3 selected internal-diagonal weights; malformed frames return -1.
contract.primary_method: Interval DP. dp[i,j] excludes boundary chord (i,j); for each split k, combine dp[i,k]+dp[k,j] and charge the child boundary chords (i,k),(k,j) when they are internal diagonals of the original polygon. Each selected diagonal is charged exactly once.
contract.independent_method: Recursively enumerate all Catalan triangulations as triangle decompositions, form each complete internal-diagonal set, and minimize its supplied-weight sum.
contract.tie_policy: Only the scalar optimum is returned, so equal-cost triangulations have identical output and require no tie rule.
contract.geometry_scope: Vertices and geometric lengths are not supplied or computed; this measures the additive triangulation DP with explicit diagonal weights.

output.encoding: minimum sum of selected internal-diagonal weights

workspace.meaning: Bounded 10x10 diagonal-cost table and 10x10 interval-DP table plus scalar bookkeeping; no dynamic allocation is required by the language ports.
